_comment: Settings for live voice-channel transcription. Read fresh on every use, so edits apply without a restart.
The `default` block applies to every server; a block under `guilds` overrides it for that server.
A server is only recorded once it has a transcript_channel. The recorder bot tokens live in .env (RECORDER_TOKENS).
enabled - master switch. false stops new recordings from starting; ones already running finish normally.
transcript_channel - ID of the text channel the transcript threads are created in. null = don't record this server.
required_category - the transcript channel must sit inside this category or the bot refuses to record.
Transcripts are every private conversation in the game, so this stops them landing in a player channel
by accident. Set to null to skip the check.
ignore_channels / ignore_categories - voice channel IDs / category IDs that are never recorded (an AFK channel, a host VC).
min_members - how many people (bots don't count) must be in a voice channel before recording starts.
empty_grace_seconds - how long the recorder waits in an empty channel before ending the thread. Someone
rejoining inside this window continues the same thread instead of starting a new one.
connect_timeout_seconds - how long a recorder gets to connect to a voice channel before giving up.
rejoin_delay_seconds - if a recorder is disconnected mid-call, how long before one is sent back in.
thread_name - {channel} is the voice channel's name, {date} and {time} are when recording started.
timezone / locale / date_format / time_format - how {date} and {time} are written (Intl.DateTimeFormat options).
thread_auto_archive_minutes - Discord only accepts 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080.
archive_thread_on_end - archive the thread when the call ends. It stays readable; this just keeps the active list clean.
silence_ms - a pause this long ends one message and starts the next. Lower = more, shorter messages.
min_utterance_ms - anything shorter than this (a cough, a mic click) is thrown away, not transcribed.
max_utterance_seconds - someone talking without pausing is cut into messages of at most this length.
sample_rate - audio quality sent for transcription. Must be 8000, 12000, 16000, 24000 or 48000.
model / api_base_url - the transcription service. Uses GROQ_API_KEY from .env.
language - spoken language code, or null to auto-detect.
prompt - optional hint text for the model, e.g. player and tribe names it keeps misspelling. Keep it short.
ignore_phrases - things the model invents from background noise. A message that is exactly one of these
AND no longer than ignore_phrases_max_ms is dropped. Not case sensitive.
message_format - one line of transcript. {name} is the speaker's server display name, {text} is what they said.
failure_format - posted when someone spoke but transcription failed, so the gap is on record. {seconds} = clip length.
start_message / end_message / join_message / leave_message / no_recorder_message / connect_failed_message /
disconnected_message - the bot's own lines. {channel}, {members}, {name} are filled in where they make sense.
log_joins_leaves - post a line in the thread when someone joins or leaves mid-call.
max_message_length - Discord's message cap is 2000; longer transcripts are split into several messages.

default.no_recorder_message: ⚠️ **{channel}** is NOT being transcribed - every recorder bot is busy or offline.
default.connect_failed_message: ⚠️ **{channel}** is NOT being transcribed - the recorder couldn't connect.
